idea-plugin.name: Easy Snippets
idea-plugin.description:
Saved terminal commands that you run with a click or a shortcut, in the classic and the new terminal, local shells and SSH sessions. Plus two tools for remote hosts: a file tree inside the terminal tab and a live log watcher.

Snippets

  • Commands with a description, in folders (nested too) or at the top level
  • Favourites popup on one shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E by default): type to filter, Enter to run
  • A shortcut of its own for any command or folder; only those appear in Settings | Keymap
  • Sequences: run a selection, a folder, or a chained command step by step. The next step starts when the previous one has finished, also over SSH and through sudo su: the plugin waits for the prompt and never types into a command that is asking for input
  • Paste-only commands, copy-instead-of-run mode, JSON import and export

Remote hosts (IDEs with SSH support and the FTP/SFTP Connectivity plugin)

  • Host files: switch an SSH terminal tab to the host's file tree and back; open and edit files, search the host, copy a download command
  • Log Watcher: follow a log file or a command such as journalctl -f over the IDE's own SSH connection, coloured by level, with search results marked on the scrollbar, a whole-file view and a download command
  • Browser console: follow the console of a page such as localhost:3000 in Chrome or Edge

Open it from View | Tool Windows | Easy Snippets.
